questions.q: Which of the following matrices is equal to $5 \begin{bmatrix} -4 & 2 \\ 0 & -5 \end{bmatrix}$?
questions.explain: To perform scalar multiplication, multiply every element inside the matrix by 5: $5 \times -4 = -20$, $5 \times 2 = 10$, $5 \times 0 = 0$, $5 \times -5 = -25$. This gives the matrix $\begin{bmatrix} -20 & 10 \\ 0 & -25 \end{bmatrix}$.
